decks.notes: The main goal of this Jund Control deck is to maintain control of the game through a combination of removal spells and powerful creatures. By efficiently removing threats with cards like Bloodchief's Thirst and Infernal Grasp, while also deploying threats like Sarulf, Realm Eater and Lolth, Spider Queen, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent. The deck also utilizes cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Esika's Chariot to generate card advantage and create a board presence. With a mix of removal, card advantage, and powerful threats, this deck aims to control the game and win through attrition.

This Jund Control deck focuses on using a combination of removal spells, creature threats, and planeswalkers to control the game and out-value the opponent. It leverages powerful cards like Lolth, Spider Queen, Ob Nixilis, the Adversary, and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to generate card advantage and maintain board control. The deck also includes various lands to ensure mana consistency and to provide utility, such as providing additional creatures or boosting the power of spells. Overall, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while building towards its own win condition.

This deck focuses on quickly and aggressively establishing board presence with a mix of powerful creatures and spells. By ramping up mana with cards like Goldspan Dragon and Magda, Brazen Outlaw, the deck can consistently play threats ahead of schedule. Esika's Chariot and Professional Face-Breaker provide additional value and pressure on opponents. The inclusion of counterspells and removal options like Disdainful Stroke and Shatterskull Smashing allows for disrupting opponent's plans while maintaining pressure. With efficient mana fixing and a well-rounded card selection, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its efficient and aggressive gameplay.

This Mono White Control deck focuses on removing threats and gaining control of the board through spells like Banishing Slash, Fateful Absence, and Doomskar. It aims to stall the game with cards like Portable Hole and Farewell while generating value with cards like Starnheim Unleashed and The Restoration of Eiganjo. Reckoner Bankbuster and The Wandering Emperor provide additional removal and win conditions, while Emeria's Call and March of Otherworldly Light offer late-game finishers. The deck also includes utility creatures like Sanctuary Warden and Elite Spellbinder, and mana sources like Eiganjo, Seat of the Empire and Crawling Barrens.

This Jund Control deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of removal spells, creature threats, and card advantage. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating value through its versatile creatures and powerful spells. The deck utilizes a mix of removal, card advantage engines, and powerful threats to out-value and outlast opponents in a standard 1 vs 1 format. By efficiently managing resources and disrupting the opponent's strategy, the deck can establish board control and seal the game in its favor.

The main concept of this Naya Aggro deck is to quickly build up a board presence and overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and powerful buffs from the Runes. Cards like Showdown of the Skalds and Runeforge Champion help to refill your hand and maintain pressure on the opponent. By utilizing efficient creatures like Jukai Naturalist and Generous Visitor, along with removal spells like Portable Hole, the deck aims to establish dominance early in the game and maintain control until the opponent is defeated.

This Orzhov Aggro deck focuses on aggression and disruption, utilizing powerful creatures like Nadaar, Selfless Paladin and Luminarch Aspirant to quickly overwhelm opponents. The deck also includes removal spells like Soul Shatter and Infernal Grasp to deal with opposing threats. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Lolth, Spider Queen and The Wandering Emperor provide additional value and resilience. The deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain board control throughout the game, ultimately securing victory through a combination of powerful creatures and disruptive spells.

This Naya Aggro deck focuses on using Rune cards to buff creatures and generate card advantage, while also utilizing powerful creatures like Runeforge Champion and Kami of Transience to quickly apply pressure on the opponent. The deck includes cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Showdown of the Skalds to further enhance its aggro strategy, with lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Lair of the Hydra providing additional utility. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of efficient creatures, powerful buffs, and impactful spells.

This deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures and boosting them with various cards such as Runes and enchantments. It aims to quickly build a board presence and overwhelm the opponent with fast, powerful attacks. The deck includes cards that provide mana acceleration, card draw, and protection for your creatures. By utilizing a mix of creatures with different abilities and power levels, as well as strategic use of your resources, this Naya Aggro deck can outpace and outmuscle your opponent to secure a victory.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy using cheap and efficient creatures in the Weenie White archetype. By playing multiple low-cost creatures like Elite Spellbinder, Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, and Luminarch Aspirant, the deck aims to quickly build a wide board presence and apply pressure early in the game. Cards like The Wandering Emperor and Intrepid Adversary provide additional support and power to push through for a quick victory against the opponent.

The deck focuses on aggressive creature plays, supported by powerful enchantments and lands to maintain control and pressure the opponent. Creature synergy and versatile removal spells provide a strong board presence and disruption against opponent's strategies. With a mix of creature buffs, removal, and land manipulation, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently. The inclusion of unique creatures and support cards enhances the deck's consistency and versatility, allowing for different angles of attack and defense.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal, and card advantage. It utilizes a mix of instant and sorcery spells to disrupt the opponent's board presence while maintaining card advantage through effects like Expressive Iteration and Memory Deluge. The win condition of the deck is to either outvalue the opponent with powerful threats like Goldspan Dragon or efficiently control the board until it can close out the game with burn spells. The lands in the deck provide both mana fixing and utility to support the overall game plan.

This deck focuses on utilizing runes to enhance creatures and create card advantage, while also ramping up quickly with mana-fixing lands. By combining aggression with card draw and mana acceleration, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures and efficient spells. The key strategy is to establish a strong board presence early on and maintain pressure throughout the game, using a combination of creatures, enchantments, and lands to outpace and outmatch the opponent.

This deck focuses on utilizing a mix of aggressive creatures and removal spells to control the board and exert pressure on the opponent. By combining efficiently costed creatures like Luminarch Aspirant and Tenacious Underdog with powerful removal spells like Vanishing Verse and The Meathook Massacre, the deck aims to quickly build a strong board presence and overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize. The deck also includes a mix of utility lands to support its game plan and provide additional options in different situations.

This deck focuses on quickly establishing a strong board presence with efficient creatures like Luminarch Aspirant and Tenacious Underdog. The deck also includes removal spells like Vanishing Verse and The Meathook Massacre to deal with opposing threats. The mana base is built to support the three-color Esper strategy, with a mix of pathways and utility lands to ensure consistent mana access. The deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain control throughout the game with a mix of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells.

This deck focuses on quickly establishing a strong board presence and overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures. By utilizing pump spells and protection spells, it aims to push damage through and maintain control of the battlefield. The deck includes powerful synergies between creatures like Clarion Spirit and Leonin Lightscribe, as well as Mavinda, Students' Advocate to recur important spells. It also includes lands that provide additional utility to further support the aggressive strategy. Overall, the deck aims to close out games quickly through efficient creature combat and clever spell usage.
